_doc: LYFT metric map for emit_matrix.py (schema v2, by Bloomberg CODE), written 2026-11-05 off inspect_matrix.py LYFT (newest snapshot 11/4/2026, 30 snapshots). Adjusted EBITDA = IS_COMPARABLE_EBITDA (company definition; FY2025 528.8). EPS = IS_COMP_EPS_GAAP (GAAP diluted; FY2025 6.81 includes the $2.9B valuation-allowance release). Net income GAAP. Rides, Active Riders and Gross Bookings are the company KPIs (kpi2/kpi1/kpi3). Insurance reserves and capex are not in the export. HEADLINE_FCF (Bloomberg's free-cash-flow series) is KEPT from 2026-11-06 on the analyst's instruction: it is not on Lyft's definition (company FCF = operating cash flow less purchases of property and equipment and scooter fleet), so a gap against the reported figure is partly definitional (e.g. 1Q25 Street 132.1 vs reported 280.7; 1Q24 42.9 vs 127.1); the pane says so.
